description: Source code for parsing line range options in a Git-related utility, including functions for parsing location specifications, regex matching, and range arguments.

methods.name: parse_loc
methods.description: Parses location specifications for line ranges, supporting relative, absolute, and regex-based locations.

methods.name: match_funcname
methods.description: Determines if a line segment likely contains a function name based on character analysis.

methods.name: find_funcname_matching_regexp
methods.description: Finds a function name line matching a given regex within a text stream.

methods.name: parse_range_funcname
methods.description: Parses a range specified by a function name pattern, using regex matching.

methods.name: parse_range_arg
methods.description: Main function to parse a range argument string into begin and end line numbers.

methods.name: skip_range_arg
methods.description: Skips over a range argument string to the next position.
